source.quote: Among this, KRW 37,740.4 billion was recognized as expenditures, excluding government subsidies and capitalized expenses. ... R&D costs (expenses) 37,740,392 34,998,142 28,339,724 [KRW million, 2025, 2024, 2023]

notes: Values in KRW billions (KRW 7,137,295 million and 37,740,392 million). Taxes from the consolidated cash flow statement (the report also prints a separate parent-only statement, not used).
